[*] [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i][/list]
Be aware that some of the information displayed in the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] is incomplete right now, to let the tournament host share more information with you at their own pace. All of the information displays what we can share at this moment and is [u][b]subject to change[/b][/u].

[h2]Stay Connected![/h2]
With the launch of this new feature, we’re taking another step towards fostering a more connected and informed esports community. Whether you’re a competitor looking to plan your next big challenge or a fan eager to follow your favorite player or teams, this calendar will be your go-to source for all things esports.

We’re incredibly excited to roll this out and make esports even more accessible. Stay tuned for further updates and new features that will make following and participating in the esports scene easier than ever!

Our recent Closed Beta and Stress Tests were invaluable for us not just testing at scale, but also hearing feedback directly from our players around the world as they got hands on with the game for the first time.  
 
One area where we heard a lot of feedback is the new deity portraits. We are building this game for you, our players, and your feedback is helping us to continue to improve and change the game. We’re not only doing this pre-launch but will continue to do so after our global full release on September 4th.  
 
Your feedback has driven and inspired us to create new deity portraits that players will get to see in the game at launch. Here we’re showcasing one deity per pantheon; Thor, Kronos, Hades and Bast.

notes.content:

The moment you’ve been waiting for is here – [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] is now in Advanced Access! This means anyone who has pre-ordered the Premium Edition on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934680/Age_of_Mythology_Retold/]Steam[/url] has exclusive access to the full game. [h2]Want to Play Now?[/h2]
[b]If you pre-order the Premium Edition of [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] during Advanced Access, the full game will unlock during that time. Don’t wait to become mythic![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934680/Age_of_Mythology_Retold/

[h2]What’s Included with Premium Edition?[/h2]
Anyone who owns the Premium Edition of [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] also gets access to the [i]Legacy Deity Portrait Pack[/i] plus the [i]New Gods Pack: Freyr[/i] to use right away! In addition, owners of the Premium Edition get the first two expansion packs upon their release.

[h3]Legacy Deity Portrait Pack[/h3]
Want to journey back in time a bit and experience the nostalgia of the original game? Now you can access the portraits from the 2002 release of [i]Age of Mythology[/i] – and use them in-game immediately!

[h3]New Gods Pack: Freyr[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894763/5260051ad12c3d47011060fb6981a5c96c42e040.png[/img]
Also included with the Premium Edition is the [i]New Gods Pack: Freyr[/i], a new type of expansion for [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i].

Challenge friends with a new Major God, Freyr, and three new Minor Gods: Ullr, Aegir, and Vidar. Leap into battle with their new god powers, myth units, and technologies, plus, battle your way across the frozen North in an exclusive mythical battle scenario, crushing your opponents with the wrathful power of your new gods!

[h3]4 New Gods[/h3]
[expand type=details]
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894763/3b2d60471615a5242c2fc27e5473a9ff6fd43991.jpg[/img][b]Freyr[/b][/td][td]The Norse major god of fertility and kingship, Freyr’s focus is defensive and technological rather than aggressive. Freyr’s god power is Gullinbursti, which temporarily summons Freyr’s magical giant golden boar to defend a Town Center.[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894763/1b88e2b7012ed89b732252474124ec97920a4a6c.jpg[/img][b]Ullr[/b][/td][td]The [u]Classical Age[/u] Norse god of oaths and archery, Ullr improves your defenses and Longhouse units. Ullr’s god power, Asgardian Bastion, allows you to erect a powerful Hill Fort-like fortification one age earlier than usual. His myth unit is the Draugr, an undead archer whose arrows penetrate multiple targets.[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894763/ee66cacf6270cd615958ce55ebaa0cf61dedd03b.jpg[/img][b]Aegir[/b][/td][td]The [u]Heroic Age[/u] Norse god of the sea and storms, Aegir boosts your myth units and siege weapons. Aegir’s god power, Tempest, calls down a vicious hailstorm that damages and greatly slows down enemy units. His myth unit is the Rock Giant, a towering personification of stone who crushes and even devours buildings.[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894763/90141a08cbc2929431a0679317727a35c3fea7b8.jpg[/img][b]Vidar[/b][/td][td]The [u]Mythic Age [/u]Norse god of vengeance and resilience, Vidar favors your human soldiers and heroes. Vidar’s god power, Inferno, unleashes a fiery path of destruction that incinerates all in its path. His myth unit is Fafnir, the infamous wingless dragon of Norse legend, who envelops enemies in fire and poisonous fumes.[/td][/tr][/table][/expand]

[h3]A New, Fully Voiced Mythical Battle[/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894763/bbc63bde4b4198ca238e6b0aa71e8f825180eac7.png[/img]
[b]Reginleif’s Rally[/b] – As his plans in Egypt unravel, Gargarensis travels north and rallies the giant clans to attack the Norse of Alfheim. Surrounded on all sides, the beleaguered Norsemen make a final stand and prepare to die valiantly when the Valkyrie Reginleif suddenly arrives to lead the defense. Will she inspire these hardy people to an unlikely victory, or will Freyr’s realm fall to the ravages of frost and flame? In this mission, you will worship the god Freyr.[/expand]

We hope you enjoy [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] and bring a friend or two! As always, we would love to hear your feedback! Visit the [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-mythology/11]official [i]Age of Empires[/i] Forums[/url] or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1934680/discussions/0/]Steam Forums[/url] to report any bugs or give any feedback – together we can continue improving [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i]!
